Main.DefaultDescription:
Sparking Unverum helps you manage your DRAGON BALL Sparking! ZERO mods!

Enable the mods you want, drag them to change their priority (the ones on top win) and press Play.

(Right click a mod > Link to GameBanana to show its info here and get its updates.)

Merge.Title: Mods with several downloads
Merge.Explanation: These mods were installed in several folders from the same GameBanana page, usually because they have several downloads. Merge them into one so they are enabled and updated together, or keep them separate to enable each part on its own. Either way each folder remembers its download so updates work.

Backups.Title: Backups
Backups.Explanation: This is what Sparking Unverum found in the mod folders of the game that it didn't put there, so nothing of yours is ever deleted. Often they are copies of mods you already have in your list: those repeated files can be deleted without losing anything. What isn't repeated stays.
